question: For which of the following dance forms was Nalini Asthana awarded the Padma Shri in 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kathak**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Nalini Asthana was awarded the Padma Shri in 2022 for her contributions to the dance form of **Kathak**.
 
• Kathak is one of the major forms of Indian classical dance.
 
• The word "Kathak" is derived from the Sanskrit word "Katha" meaning "story", and the dance form involves storytelling through dance.
 
• Kathak dancers traditionally perform to the accompaniment of classical Indian music, often featuring instruments like the tabla and harmonium.
 
• This dance form is characterized by intricate footwork, spins, and expressive gestures to convey emotions and stories.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kathakali**

 
 
• It is a major form of classical Indian dance that is distinguished by its elaborate costumes and makeup.
 
• Kathakali originated in Kerala and is known for its dramatic storytelling through facial expressions and movements.
 
 
 
• **Bharatanatyam**
 
 
• This dance form originated in Tamil Nadu and is one of the oldest classical dance traditions in India.
 
• Bharatanatyam is known for its fixed upper torso, bent legs, and intricate footwork combined with expressive hand gestures and facial expressions.
 
 
 
• **Mohiniyattam**
 
 
• Mohiniyattam is a classical dance form from Kerala, performed by women with graceful and sensuous movements.
 
• The dance style is marked by gentle, flowing movements and emphasizes feminine grace.
